name: gtme
description: Skills for running gtme campaigns: create a pipeline from a goal, walk it up the ladder from plan to armed, add a vendor adapter, and read what the ledger knows. A console beside the chat shows each run as it goes and the records waiting on you. Every fact comes from the binary (gtme help --agent, gtme help --bindings) at run time.

console.title: Show the gtme console
console.description: A pane beside the chat with the run in progress, its receipt, and Approve/Reject for records a human step is waiting on. Off, the skills work exactly as before.

gates.title: Hold armed sends and keys on the command line
gates.description: An armed gtme run that reaches a vendor waits for your yes in a dialog after a dry run of that pipeline, and a gtme secret set with the value on the command line is refused. Works whether or not the console is shown.
